observed_problem: RETROSPECTIVE_PERIOD is declared as a first-class Research Profile with BOUNDED_PERIOD temporal semantics, but the current Core v2 CLI/profile implementation exposes only Weekly and Thematic canonical initializers. A new monthly, half-year, annual or custom bounded Special therefore lacks a first-class v2 startup path.
expected_behavior: Every Research Profile advertised as first-class must have a typed canonical initializer/spec path that constructs a schema-valid Profile/State without depending on legacy edition-specific repair chains.
actual_behavior: config/survey-production-v2.json declares RETROSPECTIVE_PERIOD, while scripts/survey_production_v2.py implements weekly_profile/init-weekly and thematic_profile/init-thematic but no equivalent period_profile/init-period entrypoint.
production_workaround: Do not claim general Special readiness or approve PR #310. WU-012D must add bounded-Period startup and representative fixtures before merge.
improvement_action: Implement WU-012D: add a schema-backed canonical bounded Period spec/profile initializer supporting representative monthly, half-year, annual and custom bounded retrospectives, with reader-facing period identity derived from Profile coverage authority.
